description.narrative: The Special Multi-Partner Delivery Fund is a catalytic and innovative multi-partner financing mechanism that includes three components:• Institutional support to the LCBC: The SMDF will strengthen the institutional capacity of the LCBC to implement, oversee and manage RS SRR implementation. The planned interventions have been designed by and will be led by LCBC and coordinated with UN agencies (including UNDP, IOM, UNODC), financing institutions (including The World Bank and the African Development Bank), and civil society actors through the civil society platform. The LCBC will also take part in the Gender Seal Journey to ensure that gender is mainstreamed throughout the organization.• Disarmament, Demobilization, Rehabilitation, Reinsertion and Reintegration (DDRRR)/Screening, Prosecution, Rehabilitation and Reintegration (SPRR): To ensure exits from Boko Haram are managed across the Lake Chad Basin in a harmonized manner, the second component focuses on developing policies, capturing lessons learned and ensuring a shared understanding and learning among LCB countries. The interventions under this component are co-led and designed by the LCBC, IOM, UNODC, and UNDP• Nexus Financing Mechanism (NFF): A Nexus Funding Facility (NFF): The “Nexus Window” of the SMDF will promote and incentivize joint action along the Humanitarian, Development and Peace (HDP) spectrum to tackle common challenges in the LCB region.
